## The Anarkali, made to twirl

An Anarkali is a fitted bodice that flares into a long, flowing skirt – one of the most flattering Indian silhouettes for every body type. It is the go-to outfit for weddings, Diwali, Eid, sangeet and receptions.

## Our Anarkali styles

- **Georgette Anarkalis** – light, flowy, with gold handwork and gota lace
- **Taffeta silk Anarkalis** – rich sheen with gota work and organza dupattas
- **Nyra cut cotton suits** – a gathered A-line flare that is comfortable all day

## How to choose your Anarkali

| Occasion | Best fabric |
|---|---|
| Wedding / reception | Georgette or taffeta silk |
| Diwali party | Taffeta silk or georgette |
| Mehendi / haldi / day events | Cotton Nyra cut |

## Shipping, fit and returns

- **Free worldwide shipping** to the USA, UK, Canada, UAE and Australia, with tracking
- Ready sizes ship in 2–4 working days; made-to-measure pieces take 5–7 working days, then 5–10 business days for delivery
- **Free custom fit** – send your bust, waist, hip and height and we stitch it for you
- We send you photos of your piece before it ships
- Customs duties, if any, are charged by your country on delivery

Questions about length or fit? [WhatsApp us](https://wa.me/917073350886).

faq.q: Does the Anarkali come with a dupatta and pants?
faq.a: Yes, our Anarkali suits come as a set with matching pants and a dupatta unless the product page says otherwise.

faq.q: What if I am between sizes?
faq.a: Use the Fit Finder on any product page, or send us your bust, waist, hip and height on WhatsApp and we will stitch the piece to your measurements at no extra cost.
Ready sizes ship in 2–4 working days and made-to-measure pieces in 5–7 working days. Express delivery then takes about 5–10 business days to the USA, UK, Canada, UAE and Australia.
Shipping is free. Any import duty or tax is set by your country and, if charged, is paid on delivery. Many small orders are not charged, but it depends on your country's rules.
